compulsory_education.notes: Compulsory attendance begins at age 6. Kindergarten is not compulsory.

esa_programs.amount: $8,000/year (private school); $6,000/year (home-based, ages 12-18); $4,000/year (home-based, ages 5-11). Age determined as of September 1. Distributed in two equal payments by July 31 and December 31. Mid-year awards prorated by quarter.
esa_programs.eligibility: Utah K-12 students under age 19 as of September 1 of the scholarship year. Must verify primary residence in Utah with current-year documentation (utility bill, mortgage statement, lease, or property tax records). Cannot simultaneously receive a Carson Smith Scholarship.
esa_programs.name: Utah Fits All Scholarship

esa_programs.amount: K-12: weighted pupil unit x 2.5 (no income tiers); Preschool full-time: value of weighted pupil unit; Preschool part-time: weighted pupil unit x 0.55. No income-based eligibility tiers.
esa_programs.eligibility: Students with qualifying disabilities under IDEA (20 USC 1401(3)), documented by an IEP within the previous 3 years or a multidisciplinary team evaluation. Must be a primary resident of Utah with verification (utility bill, lease, property tax records, or income tax records). Each child must independently qualify; no sibling pass-through. Cannot simultaneously receive Utah Fits All or legacy Carson Smith Scholarship. Preschoolers who are homeschooled are not eligible.
esa_programs.name: Carson Smith Opportunity Scholarship

notification.deadline: before the child begins home schooling
notification.recipient: local school board (board of education of the school district where the child resides)

additional_statutes: Utah Code 53E-7-402 et seq. (Carson Smith Opportunity Scholarship)
Utah Code 53F-6-401 et seq. (Utah Fits All Scholarship)
